text:
nina: starting a short thread to finalize the rollout gates + provisioning table for multi-tenant isolation. need clear owners and numeric thresholds.
omar: propose concrete wave definitions: W0 internal, W1 opt-in pilots (<=10 tenants), W2 broad pilots (10-100), W3 contractual GA. each wave must have eviction budget and cross-region egress cap.
tara: infra constraints: pre-warm per-tenant shards, reserved GPU footprint, and cross-region bandwidth headroom. i'll publish a provisioning table but need tenant traffic percent and sample prompts.
ben: SRE checklist: p95 latency delta threshold +5%, error-rate spike alert (>3x baseline), fallback-rate alert (>1% absolute), and rollback target <10 minutes. include chaos tests for node evacuation.
viv: product ops will draft pilot comms, opt-in contract addendum, and compensation policy. ask: do we want to allow early region pin requests?
omar: no region pinning until W2. pinning forces dedicated capacity reservation and longer lead time. keep W1 global best-effort.
tara: routing policy sketch (plain text): priorities = [region_affinity, tenant_quota, cost_class]; fallback_chain = [quantized-lite, regional-aux, shared-economy]; eviction_threshold = 0.85.
ben: telemetry must expose: per-tenant cache_hit_rate, fallback_pct, token_cost_delta, and route_latency_p95. needs dashboard and alert runbook.
ina: launch gates (draft):
- Gate A (internal): 48h internal traffic, no P1s
- Gate B (pilot): 7-day pilot, <=10 tenants, p95 +5% allowed, fallback <=1%
- Gate C (broad): 30-day pilot, region-aware options, cross-region egress <5%
- Gate D (GA): legal + compliance for pinned tenants and SLA signoff
viv: ops action: I'll collect pilot tenant samples and send to Tara by EOW. also will prepare customer-facing migration FAQ.
mar: ops-bot: reminder: use RFC tag `isolation-rollout` and attach provisioning table.
oma r: next steps: Tara publish provisioning table + cost projection by Thu, Ben author chaos scenarios, Omar iterate routing DSL example, Viv secure pilot roster. Nina will assemble exec one-pager.
